fate: Lived out his life in exile at Circeii, keeping only his priesthood. He died around 13–12 BCE, and Augustus then took the title Pontifex Maximus.
moments: Becomes Pontifex Maximus after Caesar's death, 44 BCE
Stripped of power after his troops desert to Octavian, 36 BCE
name: Marcus Aemilius Lepidus
summary: Caesar's deputy who became the third and weakest member of the Second Triumvirate.
